description: Compare every way to get between Seatac Airport (SEA) and a Seattle-area place for one trip: a private Seatac Connection ride, driving and parking at the SEA garage, a rental car, app rideshare or taxi, and Link light rail. Priced options carry real numbers (Port of Seattle garage rates, typical rental costs, example or live ride fares); rideshare and light rail are described, not priced, because their prices are not fixed. direction: "departing" (flying out of SEA: the alternative is parking), "arriving" (visiting: the alternative is a rental), or "both". Ranks the priced options cheapest first.

address.description: Optional exact pickup/drop-off address in the Seattle area for a live fare instead of the stored example fare, e.g. "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Needs pickup_datetime. Uses one rate-limited live quote.

area.description: Seattle-area place the trip starts or ends at (default downtown-seattle).

bags.description: Checked-size bags for the live fare (0-12, default 2).

direction.description: departing = a local flying out of SEA (compare parking); arriving = a visitor flying in (compare a rental); both (default).

passengers.description: Passengers for the live fare (1-12, default 2).

pickup_datetime.description: With address: the ride's pickup date and time, ISO 8601, Seattle local time when no offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30.

rental_daily_rate.description: Optional: the traveler's own daily rental rate before tax, USD.

trip_days.description: Length of the trip in days (1-30): days parked, or nights in town for a rental.

name: compare_airport_options
title: Compare ways to and from SEA
